concepts.label: Environment & life safety
concepts.description: Physical environment and Life Safety Code: smoke barriers, egress, sprinklers, fire alarms, electrical and gas systems.

concepts.label: Clinical care
concepts.description: Quality of care, assessment and care planning: pressure injuries, falls, care plans, treatment and monitoring.

concepts.label: Resident rights & abuse/neglect
concepts.description: Dignity, choice, privacy, grievances, freedom from abuse, neglect, exploitation and restraints.

concepts.label: Medication management
concepts.description: Pharmacy services, drug regimen review, medication errors, unnecessary or psychotropic drugs.

concepts.label: Food, nutrition & hydration
concepts.description: Dietary services, food safety and storage, nutrition and hydration.

concepts.label: Infection prevention
concepts.description: Infection prevention and control programs, antibiotic stewardship, immunizations.

concepts.label: Emergency preparedness
concepts.description: Emergency plans, communication, training, testing and emergency power (E-tags).

concepts.label: Staffing & supervision
concepts.description: Nursing and physician services, sufficient and competent staff, supervision.

concepts.label: Administration & records
concepts.description: Administration, governance, QAPI, compliance programs and records.
